answer: Deposits are visible in meadow, and horizon reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 184 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ridge account. Each duplicate costs another 96 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
